status.scope: Unchanged C1/C2 revision certificates, fresh amended C3-C7 boundary and runtime validation, preserved source history, and complete changed-path accounting. Final report content/render review and final head identity require a separate external closure receipt; recorded snapshots retain their own execution scope.

input_snapshot.meaning: Observed input snapshot, not a final self-hash.

method.inventory: Every original source commit is listed once. All paths in all seven current parent-to-child diffs are enumerated, including deletions, binary files, fixtures and docs. No Git rename detection hides old/new paths.
method.mapping: Semantic owner summaries derive from source descriptions and complete path inventories. Candidate path overlaps do not establish source-hunk identity; mixed files, squashed superseded code and moved fixtures are explicit.
method.coverage: Pinned actual review evidence is reused only with identical boundary blobs or identical complete diff text after omitting Git index/line-number headers. Unmatched prior scopes and later amendments remain separate unresolved statuses; an aggregate scope is reusable only when its complete boundary blobs match. Artifact byte audits are distinguished from line-by-line code review.
method.limits: This artifact does not certify compilation, tests, physics, final amended diffs or a final seven-commit history. Refresh after every owning-commit amendment.

proof_policy: Preserve aggregate exact-boundary reuse, complete actual-diff review, explicit amendment composition, semantic artifact audit, and exact historical page-render reuse as distinct methods. Reading coverage is not test success.

amendment.scope: GL00/GL04 exact reconstruction certificate and owning architecture explanation; production code unchanged

closeout.boundary_reuse: C1/C2 reuse passing receipts for identical commits; C3-C7 gates and final runtime are fresh.
